text:
amy_sales: Heads up — Prospect 'Northbridge' is doing a large embeddings migration and they're getting 429s intermittently. Big demo Friday, need a quick presales triage. tagging @li_se and @ravi_eng

li_se: Can you paste a client error sample and the import pattern? number of processes/workers?

amy_sales: Client snippet (redacted):

amy_sales: ```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxx
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: nb_req_9001

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 20
{"error":{"message":"rate limit exceeded","code":429}}
```

amy_sales: They're launching a parallel job: 120 workers hitting /v1/embeddings with batch_size=512. Also some hits to chat for enrichment.

ravi_eng: That size is aggressive. On our side I'm seeing per-tenant soft quota=100 r/s and a shared token cap kicking in when token/sec > ~120k. The client batch_size*seq_len estimates push tokens high. Are they on a trial with sandbox pricing?

amy_sales: Yes trial; sales asked about a temporary push and whether that will incur overage. They want to know pricing if we bump quota for a day.

sam_infra: Two quick levers: 1) short-lived tenant bump to 200 r/s and enable backpressure queueing on the embeddings route (smooths spikes), 2) enable token-token auto-eviction on excessive KV cache use (lowers memory pressure, slight perf hit), 3) recommend client reduce batch_size to 128 and add jittered backoff.

toni_sre: From SRE perspective, queueing is safest for hosted shared pool. Bump needs ops approval because it changes rate accounting and could impact other shared tenants if sustained. If sales wants the bump just for the demo window we can do a scoped change with a 4-hour TTL. Monitoring alarms will auto-revert on abnormal host load.

ops_bot: ops_bot: "Initiating tenant change request: change_req_nb_42 created by ravi_eng"

ravi_eng: I'll prepare the rollout: tenant NB-202 -> soft_quota=200 r/s, route_queueing=true with max_concurrent=40, ttl=4h. Will also flip on logging to capture X-RateLimit-Remaining per-route every 10s for detailed telemetry.

clara_support: I'll send the client a compact retry strategy and a sample import runner modification. Also flag the client for pricing FAQ: temporary bump will be billed as short-term reserved uplift at our trial uplift rate (cc finance).

li_se: Can finance confirm cost? Sales needs a dollar estimate to share. Also add a presales checklist item: if import parallelism > 50 workers then require preflight with ops for a bump.

amy_sales: Finance: any quick guidance on demo uplift pricing?

ops_bot: ops_bot: "finance_notif: request forwarded to finance-ops (ticket FIN-982)"

toni_sre: One more note — some 429s appear correlated with concurrent chat enrichments that use long prompts. If they can defer chat enrichment until after embeddings import, token pressure will drop significantly. Recommend sequencing imports then enrichment.

ravi_eng: Implemented change-id cfg_nb_900 via ops. Deploy log: `ops_bot: payload applied (cfg_nb_900)`. Watching metrics.

cla ra_support: (typo) Clara: Customer reports initial rerun improved; only spike when they restarted all 120 workers simultaneously. Backoff logic mitigated subsequent waves. Demo tentatively green.

amy_sales: Summary for records: cause = oversized client concurrency + large batch sizes causing token/sec to exceed tenant soft quota; fix = temporary quota bump + route queueing + client-side batch/backoff + sequence enrichment after import. Action items: 
- li_se: add preflight check to presales checklist for large imports
- ravi_eng / sam_infra: leave TTLed bump in place until demo, monitor metrics
- clara_support: send client retry/backoff patch and pricing note
- toni_sre: confirm auto-revert alarms and impact window

li_se: I'll add the checklist entry and a short presales runbook. Thanks team.

amy_sales: Thanks all, huge help.
